# TPC-Havoc Q2_v5

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH min_costs AS (
  SELECT
    ps_partkey AS min_ps_partkey,
    MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
  FROM partsupp, supplier, nation, region
  WHERE
    s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
    AND s_nationkey = n_nationkey
    AND n_regionkey = r_regionkey
    AND r_name = 'EUROPE'
  GROUP BY
    ps_partkey
)
SELECT
  s_acctbal,
  s_name,
  n_name,
  p_partkey,
  p_mfgr,
  s_address,
  s_phone,
  s_comment
FROM part, supplier, partsupp, nation, region, min_costs AS mc
WHERE
  p_partkey = ps_partkey
  AND s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
  AND p_size = 15
  AND p_type LIKE '%BRASS'
  AND s_nationkey = n_nationkey
  AND n_regionkey = r_regionkey
  AND r_name = 'EUROPE'
  AND p_partkey = mc.min_ps_partkey
  AND ps_supplycost = mc.min_cost
ORDER BY
  s_acctbal DESC,
  n_name,
  s_name,
  p_partkey
```
